rawContent: A room of mostly male union members laughing at a gross joke about consent made by a public figure who has been called out for inappropriately touching women...is my very particular and specific hellscape. #metoo #1u

Women make up only slightly more than 3% of all workers in trades b/c of a boys club of sexual harassment, abuse & gate-keeping. Is the @IBEW & @NABTU leadership going to protect ALL workers so that women can have access to good jobs to support their families? #1u #MeToo
